$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs (manager/rules/SEO.md): by CI after every deploy, or run by hand from a fresh clone of main while GitHub Actions is locked (BRIEF-3.md). actorId pins the Actor that the first apify push created on 2026-11-08 (build 1.0.1), so a rename in actor.json updates the same Actor. isPublic stays false until the priced proof run on Apify and the owner's final check.
seoTitle: Hirist Jobs Scraper - IT Jobs by Skill & Experience
seoDescription: Search every hirist.tech job at once: IT and tech jobs in India by title, skill, city and years of experience, newest first, with pay in lakhs. No login.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 512 MB, measured on Apify on 2026-11-08 (build 1.0.1): the example search took 10 s at 512 MB, 1 GB and 2 GB alike (6 calls, 80 MB peak), so more memory buys a keyword search no speed and 512 MB halves its compute; a rare word reads every job, 240 calls, 70 s and 0.0098 CU at 512 MB against 46 s and 0.0127 CU at 1 GB; every job, 28,358 rows, took 94 s with a 254 MB peak at 512 MB. Start events are one per run up to 1 GB, so 512 MB costs the user the same.

pricing.$comment: Owner rule 2026-11-08 (BRIEF-3.md section 3): measured Apify cost plus a markup by tier, FREE 150%, BRONZE 140%, SILVER 125%, GOLD 110%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 100%; markup = (0.8 x price - cost) / cost, cost at each tier's unit prices from https://docs.apify.com/platform/actors/publishing/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md (read 2026-11-08; PLATINUM and DIAMOND at GOLD's), prices rounded up to two significant figures, none under $0.00001. Cost model at 512 MB from 8 Apify runs of build 1.0.1 on 2026-11-08 (BBV3yOUnfJjLVYjvq every job, YB6lDCKHLOp3oG6f3 1,000 jobs, KheURfRwJZKkUgxbc and hJ8pAKZUvEwVonoxS with details, and four searches): a job costs $0.0000051 at FREE (a dataset write and a little compute), a job with details $0.0000059, a run $0.00034 fixed. The run start, $0.0068 per GB, is raised from $0.0011 (that fixed cost at 150%) so that every measured run clears a 100% markup on every tier: the binding run is a rare word, rust, at 1 GB (s6fIzQGs5blGhyzZx: 32 jobs after reading all 28,769, $0.0029 of usage), 101% on FREE and BRONZE; at the default 512 MB alone it would need $0.0054. House rule for comparison (SEO.md 16, 5-15% under themineworks/hirist-jobs-scraper): $0.0036 a job, $0.0037 with details, $0.0045 start. isPublic stays false until the owner's final check.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: First pricing: measured cost plus a 100-150% markup by tier

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, locations, remote or onsite, years of experience, skills, pay in lakhs, company rating, posting date and job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, the number of applicants, the recruiter's own apply link when given, and the city, state and country.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory and once more for each extra GB, so $0.0068 at the default 512 MB. It pays for a search whose words are rare, which reads all of Hirist's jobs whatever it finds.
